purpose: Bind each structurally validated provisional subskill to a deterministic evidence-scored assessment target without claiming that synthetic scoring proves learner mastery, psychometric validity, retention, transfer, workplace effectiveness, SME approval, or certification equivalence.
identity_and_provenance_rules: subskill_id must resolve to exactly one structurally validated provisional subskill and parent_requirement_id must match that subskill's canonical frozen parent.
source_locator and preserved_cognitive_level must equal the frozen 2022 source-index values for the parent requirement.
capability_statement must equal the structurally validated provisional subskill capability statement; target binding may not silently rewrite the capability.
provenance_refs must include the exact source-node identity and exact subskill identity.
No 2026 or later standard may substitute for or reinterpret the frozen 2022 requirement identity.
assessment_design_rules: The target must elicit evidence of the capability_statement rather than only recognition of the requirement title.
prompt_contract must state what evidence is supplied, what action is required, and which unavailable facts must not be assumed.
scoring_assertions must contain at least two independent deterministic assertions unless preserved_cognitive_level is REMEMBER, where one exact recall assertion is permitted.
Each scoring assertion must name an observable response property and a deterministic pass condition; no assertion may depend on hidden evaluator preference or an unobserved real-world outcome.
insufficient_evidence_behavior must define when the correct behavior is to flag, abstain, qualify, or request missing evidence instead of guessing.
Synthetic fixtures may validate schema and scoring behavior only; they are not learner or psychometric evidence.

must_pass: source drift, parent mismatch, capability rewrite, cognitive drift, missing evidence handling, nondeterministic scoring, and human/psychometric claim fixtures rejected

on_pass: Bind assessment targets to all 66 provisional subskills in exact frozen source order using bounded batches, while unresolved dependency candidates remain separate and human/psychometric evidence remains UNOBSERVED.
